secondaries.text: Turning the clock back to 2024: Darby Allin vs. Brandon Cutler vs. Brody King vs. Claudio Castagnoli vs. Jay Lethal vs. Jeff Jarrett vs. Kip Sabian vs. Kyle O'Reilly vs. Lio Rush vs. Matt Menard vs. Matt Taven vs. Mike Bennett vs. Nick Wayne vs. Orange Cassidy vs. Roderick Strong vs. The Beast Mortos vs. The Butcher vs. Tomohiro Ishii settled things in a Royal Rampage match, kicking off the show on Rampage, rated 6.74 ? part of that year's Royal Rampage '24.

In his first PPV main event, Kevin Knight pushed Kenny Omega to the brink, but the "God of Pro Wrestling" willed his way to a win to retain the AEW World Championship at Redemption.
